title: Consumer complaint against Viagogo under the DSA
discussion_signal: The consumer-advocacy post describes complaints to digital-service coordinators about Viagogo’s pressure, recommender, trader-traceability, and speculative-pricing practices. It shows how complaint pressure is being translated into formal platform-governance and remedy demands.
linked_research_question: How do consumer complaints become enforceable platform transparency, pressure, identity, ranking, and remedy controls?
limits: Advocacy post states the complainant’s position
Complaint is not proof of a legal violation or final remedy
No prevalence estimate of affected consumers
